mean_cn: v.拼写；  n.一段时间；咒语
mean_en: to say or write the letters of a word in the correct order; to form words correctly from individual letters; to form words when they are put together in a particular order
sentence: Sometimes we can play word games to learn how to spell.
sentence_trans: 有时候我们能通过玩拼字游戏来学会拼写。
